meta.name: wei-liao-conquest-strategy
meta.description: Use when facing a coalition of rival states or planning to disrupt enemy alliances (合从). Allocates resources for bribing key officials (豪臣), sowing discord to prevent unified action, then executing military conquest. Proposed by Wei Liao to Qin Shi Huang.

copy.tagline: 用合纵连横策略瓦解敌盟并实施军事征服
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多国博弈中制定离间与征服策略
copy.tagline_en: Disrupt enemy alliances and execute military conquest using ancient strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to devise divide-and-conquer and conquest strategies in multi-state conflicts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按照战国谋士尉缭的策略行动：先评估敌方联盟威胁，然后分配资金贿赂敌方高级官员，制造分裂，最后进行军事征服。
howto.when: 当你面对多个敌对国家可能形成联盟，或想要破坏敌方联盟时触发。

say.text: 我们正面对多个敌国联盟，请按尉缭策略执行。
say.note: Claude会开始分析并执行贿赂与征服计划。

say.text: 如何用贿赂瓦解六国合纵？
say.note: Claude会阐述具体步骤和资源分配。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude follows Wei Liao's strategy: assess coalition threat, allocate funds to bribe key officials, sow discord to break alliances, then proceed with military conquest.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you face multiple rival states that might form alliances, or when you plan to disrupt enemy coalitions.

say_en.text: We face a coalition of enemy states. Execute Wei Liao's strategy.
say_en.note: Claude will start analysis and plan bribery and conquest.

say_en.text: How to bribe the six states to break their alliance?
say_en.note: Claude will explain steps and resource allocation.
